ajustes.avisos_explicacion: When a channel fails or the broadcast drops, Splitstream can notify you on Discord, Slack, or any server that accepts JSON.
ajustes.cuentas_explicacion: Accounts connected by code (Twitch, YouTube) or by redirect (Kick): they give title, category, and read-only chat to their destinations. Connect them from each channel's dialog.
ajustes.desconectar_mensaje: This will unlink {n} channel{lista}; chat and title will stop working for it.
ajustes.desconectar_mensaje_plural: This will unlink {n} channels{lista}; chat and title will stop working for them.
ajustes.desconectar_sin_canales: This account has no linked channels; only the account will be removed.
ajustes.grabacion_explicacion: Saves a copy of every broadcast on the server, in FLV and in segments, without transcoding. If the disk can't keep up, the recording degrades, never the live stream.
ajustes.idioma_nota: Log events and server logs stay in Spanish: they're evidence of what happened, not part of the interface.
ajustes.necesita_reconectar: The account needs to reconnect. Open it from Edit → Account on the destination, in the Panel.
ajustes.parar_grabacion_mensaje: You're live. The current segment will be closed and the rest won't be recorded.
ajustes.respaldo_p1_bold: Without your master key, the file is useless
ajustes.respaldo_p1_pre: Download a copy of the database: channels, encrypted keys, and the panel password.
ajustes.respaldo_p2: You can't while a broadcast is in progress: the copy locks the database and would slow down your channels. Download it once you're done.
ajustes.tope_gb_hint: Once reached, the oldest ones get deleted

asistente_credenciales.por_que_kick: Kick doesn't support public apps shared across different installations: each integration needs its own registered app. There's no way around this.
asistente_credenciales.por_que_pregunta: Why are they asking for this?
asistente_credenciales.por_que_youtube: YouTube allocates its API quota per project, not per user: if Splitstream used an app shared by everyone, anyone could exhaust it and leave you unable to create broadcasts. With your own project, the quota is yours alone.

creditos.motor.go_rtmp: RTMP client and server. It's what talks to OBS and to the platforms.
creditos.motor.sqlite: SQLite rewritten in pure Go. It's what lets a single binary run on five platforms without a C compiler.
creditos.motor.websocket: The WebSocket that pushes state to the panel every second.
creditos.subtitulo: Self-hosted RTMP relay. It receives a stream from OBS and forwards it simultaneously to multiple platforms, without transcoding.

diagnostico.apagado.detalle: It receives nothing while it's off.
diagnostico.corte.consejo: It's usually because the broadcast is no longer open on the platform, the key expired, or you hit its limit of active broadcasts.
diagnostico.corte.detalle: {n} reconnects. The platform accepts the connection and closes it right away.
diagnostico.error.consejo: Check the destination's URL and key.
diagnostico.espera.detalle: It will connect as soon as you start streaming from OBS.
diagnostico.perdidas.consejo: Your upload can't keep up with all destinations, or this platform is slow. Lower the bitrate in OBS or turn off a destination.
diagnostico.perdidas.detalle: It's dropping video to keep up ({n} frames).
diagnostico.reconectando.detalle: The connection dropped and it's trying again.
diagnostico.sin_envio.consejo: Check the key: that's what fails almost always. If you just pasted it, make sure you copied all of it.
diagnostico.sin_envio.detalle: {n} attempts without managing to send anything.
diagnostico.suspendido.consejo: Check the URL and key and press “Retry”. If you do nothing, it will try again on the next broadcast.
diagnostico.suspendido.detalle: It stopped retrying for this broadcast.
